name: validation-upstream-eslint-plugin-react
description: eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 as published, on the ESLint and parsers its own CI installs for ESLint 9 (eslint@9, @typescript-eslint/parser@8.17, babel-eslint@10, over its package.json devDependencies; it commits no lockfile): the parsers tests/helpers/parsers.js require.resolves, the latest TypeScript @typescript-eslint/parser 8.17 supports (upstream's own ^3.9.9 cannot load it), and the helpers' own requirements.
